title: The Supervisor splits the daily new-people slots across flows by results, and the Owner applies the split
description: Hub model, decision kind Allocate (2026-11-11): today each flow's per_day is set alone, so a flow that gets replies cannot borrow slots from one that does not. A pure allocate(total, flows) splits the Owner's daily total (default 10, 1 to 100) across the enabled flows that take new people a day, using each flow's last 30 days of sends and responses (recentResults). Flows that are off get 0; every enabled flow keeps at least 1; a flow with fewer than 8 sends counts as no data and flows with no data split evenly; among flows with data, a better response rate never gets fewer slots. Every share carries a plain why. The split is a proposal: GET /v1/supervisor shows allocation { total, by_flow, why, applied } and nothing moves a flow's per_day until the Owner applies it with POST /v1/supervisor/allocation/apply. POST /v1/supervisor/allocation { total } sets the total. At Autopilot a later row may apply it without asking; this row never does. Wave 3 of the master plan v2.
acceptance: allocate splits evenly with no data, toward better rates with data, keeps 1 for every enabled flow and 0 for flows that are off
GET /v1/supervisor allocation proposes 5 and 5 for two enabled flows with no data and moves no per_day
POST /v1/supervisor/allocation sets the total (bad 400, no session 401); POST /v1/supervisor/allocation/apply writes each share as the flow's per_day
